summary: A tags input component for adding and managing removable tag items.
shortDescription: The Tags Input component renders an array of removable tags within an input field, allowing users to add new tags through text entry. Built on Reka UI's tags-input primitive, it handles tag creation on Enter or delimiter, removal via backspace or click, and keyboard navigation between tags. Ideal for multi-value inputs like product tags, email recipients, or search keywords where users need to enter multiple discrete values.
